$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 §13.5 — DraftGuru annual-page acquisition contract (approved runbook: AFLDB-ISSUE-093-DRAFTGURU-ACQUISITION-HANDOFF.md). Pins the URL pattern, expected year set, intentional coverage gaps, canonical player_url form (U1, resolved 2026-08-26 against afldb_dev), accepted header variants, field classification and the CSV parity baseline. acquire_draft.py and parse_draft_snapshot.py fail closed on anything this contract does not accept. Statuses/baselines are measured evidence, never assumption.

canonical_player_url.href_source_form: root-relative /players/<slug>/<ordinal> in server-rendered annual HTML (Step 2 probe, 2026-08-26)
canonical_player_url.ordinal: positive integer path segment; meaningful durable person identity — never stripped, collapsed or defaulted
canonical_player_url.evidence: U1 RESOLVED 2026-08-26: read-only afldb_dev measurement — all 5,057 draft_persons.player_url values are absolute https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/<slug>/<ordinal>, 0 trailing slashes, all end in a numeric ordinal; anchors https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/brad_miller/1 and https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/brad_miller/2

regression_anchor.note: Identical rendered names, distinct hrefs — the proven-incorrect automatic convergence; must remain two persons through every stage

live_header_rule: An accepted live annual-page header is the year's CSV variant header exactly, or that header with a single final 'Trade' column appended (measured live 2001: 16 columns = variant C + Trade; the browser export silently dropped that column). Any other header fails closed — never best-effort.

Pick.semantics: special-pick LABEL (Priority/Compensation/FA Compensation/Inactive/Penalised), not a pick number

# ↧.semantics: selection number within the event; blank means NOT-APPLICABLE (exactly Trade, Pre-Draft, Post-Draft, Free Agency), never 0 and never not-recorded

Club.semantics: DESTINATION club under DraftGuru's modern identity — era-aware AFLDB resolution required downstream, failing closed on 'Brisbane'

Detail.semantics: DISTINCT field from Signing — holds player names and 'Brisbane'

Player.semantics: display name only, NBSP-separated; NEVER identity — identity is the player href alone

Original Club.semantics: recruiting PATHWAY, '/'-separated, ZWSP-delimited; never an FK, never previous AFL club

Games.semantics: career figure coerced to 0 at source — violates NULL≠0 at source

Goals.semantics: career figure coerced to 0 at source

Coaches.semantics: Coaches Association votes, coerced to 0 at source

Brownlow.semantics: career Brownlow votes, coerced to 0 at source; AFLDB holds the authoritative grain

Awards.semantics: denormalised display string; awards domain later (§13.6)

Trade.semantics: live-only column, semantics UNKNOWN — profiled across all 42 pages (runbook §9) before any database destination is assigned

parity_baseline.note: Live-source drift from this baseline is investigated and explicitly recorded, never silently accepted (runbook §7/§8, unresolved decision U5); --accept-baseline-drift is the explicit per-run human acknowledgement and records the measured delta

csv_artifact.role: independent validation/parity oracle only — read-only; the export stripped player/club hyperlinks and the Trade column

http_policy.robots_txt: fetched once, hash recorded; a disallow on the target paths stops the run

comparison_normalisation.$comment: Applied ONLY when comparing values for parity — never to raw/ bytes, never to stored raw text fields.
comparison_normalisation.whitespace: runs collapsed to a single space, ends stripped
comparison_normalisation.mojibake_repair: CSV-side only, player names only: if the CP1252/Latin-1 mojibake signature U+00C3 is present, attempt s.encode('latin-1').decode('utf-8'); on failure keep the original. Every applied repair is enumerated in the parity report.
